generic_domain.justification: ML Theory is chosen because it serves as the foundational framework that underpins all other areas within machine learning. It encompasses a wide range of concepts such as algorithms, their learning capabilities, computational complexity, and generalization. This domain provides the principles and methodologies that are applicable across various specialized domains like deep learning, reinforcement learning, neural networks, optimization techniques, Bayesian methods, and more. By focusing on ML Theory, it allows for a comprehensive understanding that can integrate and unify these diverse areas into a cohesive body of knowledge.
